champion.tips: MAOKAI TIPS AND TRICKS Maokai’s Ultimate R is great in team fights. Once you engage with your Ultimate R , fall back and protect your carries. Place down as many Saplings E as possible before your first camp spawns. Place them in a bush when possible. Your goal in the early game is to gank as much as you can with your point and click CC W . Try and get your allies ahead from the get-go.
champion.builds: THE BEST MAOKAI BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Maokai Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Phase Rush as your keystone, followed by Nimbus Cloak, Transcendence and Waterwalking in the primary tree, as well as Cosmic Insight and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Ability Haste in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Liandry's Torment as your first item, followed by Mercury's Treads and Unending Despair. For your last 3 items, you should build Spirit Visage, Randuin's Omen and finish with Thornmail. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 46.5% winrate over 200 matches played. Optional Your second option for Maokai Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Aftershock as your keystone, Font of Life, Conditioning and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Legend: Haste with Triumph in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Sunfire Aegis, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Unending Despair as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Jak'Sho, The Protean, Randuin's Omen and Spirit Visage. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 57.3% win rate over 82 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Phase Rush as your keystone, Nimbus Cloak, Transcendence and Waterwalking in the primary tree, and Cosmic Insight with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree, as well as Ability Haste, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Sunfire Aegis as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Unending Despair as a third item. You want to finish the build with Thornmail, Spirit Visage and Randuin's Omen. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 57.4% win rate across 61 matches played. Situational Maokai Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Maokai build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Maokai runes page.
